laws: registry entries are rebuildable projections over canonical source/config/contracts and cannot grant authority
CANONICAL entries bind only current source-owner paths; tools are CANDIDATE or HISTORICAL_RETIRED
effect-capable entries require an explicit effect authority class and reconciliation obligations
PRODUCTION_FINANCIAL_WRITE cannot become admitted while contracts/production-authorization.json is BLOCK_NOT_GRANTED
provider truth, owner mandate, Runtime physical execution, Host continuity and Network transport remain externally owned
